title: Bacolod mayor orders burial of 3-ton whale shark; cause of death unknown

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Mayor Greg Gasataya has ordered the burial of a whale shark weighing an estimated three to four tons after it was found stranded and dead along the shoreline of Barangay 35 on Friday, with authorities yet to determine the cause of its death. A joint on-site assessment by the City Agriculture Office and the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) found no evidence of injuries or abuse inflicted by humans on the marine animal, according to a statement issued by the Bacolod City Communications Office on Sunday.
